explanation.surface: A sort of coal that will not light at first.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Initially failing' seems to describe the coal, but it drops its first letter.
explanation.definitionFit: To ignite is to begin burning or to set alight, so to start flaming.

clue.text: Element in any way reduced from a recent delivery

indicators.note: reduced means made shorter, so the phrase loses its final letter

blocks.note: neon is a chemical element
'at all' means in any way

explanation.surface: A substance reduced in some form from a fresh shipment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Delivery' sounds like a parcel arriving, but it is a birth.
explanation.definitionFit: Neonatal refers to newborn babies, so relating to a child just born.

clue.text: Shape of game piece given to players

blocks.note: a die is a cube thrown in board games
the cast of a play are its players

explanation.surface: The form of a board-game token handed out to the participants.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Players' looks like game players, but it means actors.
explanation.definitionFit: To die-cast metal is to form it by forcing it into a mould, so to give it a shape.
